body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: efe47c9ded3b82da491fd14cb920e0a40818d86a -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blockers found. The on-screen look of the side view was not hand-checked (no GUI launched) and needs the maintainer's eye.

**What looks good**
- Display only, verified: the cutter is read only by `app::tool_cutter` (`cutter_of`/`shown`), the commands (`tool.rs`, `delete_entity.rs`, `SetToolCutter`), the project wire, the MCP tools and the UI. No sim, motion, post, cl, geometry, `tool_body::judged`/`stack` or verify reads it.
- `SetToolCutter` validates at creation and refuses by name; undo restores the previous outline (or none); redo re-applies; deleting a tool snapshots and restores its cutter.
- Lathe tools are refused by `cutter_profile::check`/`agrees` and never see the Draw cutter toggle (`tool_profile_page.rs:32`, `milling` gate).
- Tolerance is a named constant, `AGREE = 1e-3` mm (`crates/tools/src/cutter_profile.rs:16`), no exact float equality on user input.
- MCP input is bounded: `read_points` caps rows at `MAX_POINTS` before parsing and returns named errors for malformed rows (`mcp/cutter_tools.rs:56-72`).
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in the new non-test code. No snapshot PNG changed. Decisions file present (`docs/decisions/93-spun-cutter-profile.md`). Body complete with `Changelog:` and `Refs #93`.

**Local results (trial merge of efe47c9d with origin/main bdd29e00, no conflicts)**
```
cargo test -p camcraft-app --test tool_cutter_profile   5 passed, 0 failed
cargo test -p camcraft-app --test tool_spun_profile     7 passed, 0 failed
cargo test -p camcraft-app --test tool_body            12 passed, 0 failed
cargo test -p camcraft-app --test sim_tool_body         7 passed, 0 failed
cargo test -p camcraft-app --test project_roundtrip    71 passed, 0 failed
cargo test -p camcraft-app --test tool_library         13 passed, 0 failed
cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp                  13 passed, 0 failed
cargo test -p camcraft-tools                           54 + 3 passed, 0 failed
cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib -- tool_ (from crates/ui)   41 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored
cargo clippy -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings   clean
```
Not run: release tier, `--ignored` lanes, the full quick gate, the snapshot lane (not run by policy).

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. Older builds: `ToolDto` has no `deny_unknown_fields` (`crates/app/src/project/file.rs:292`), so an older build ignores the `cutter` key. Reading is safe, but saving a cutter-bearing project from an older build silently drops the drawn outline (display data only, nothing computed changes). Suggest one line in the release notes; no version bump is owed for reading.
2. Over-400 growth, flagged not blocking: `crates/ui/src/state.rs` (4278 lines, +16), `crates/app/src/schema.rs` (558, +10), `crates/app/src/project/file.rs` (532, +9). The new files are all under 400 lines.
3. The `ChangeTool` refusal (`crates/app/src/commands/tool.rs:124-132`) only fires for a tool with a drawn cutter, so a normal edit of a tool without one is unaffected. The message names the tool and says to reset the cutter to Parametric first. No MCP tool edits tool numbers through `ChangeTool` (MCP `set_tool` assigns a tool to an operation), so there is no second path to check.
4. The PR body quotes the quick gate on head 943eee69; this review ran on the final head efe47c9d (trial merge), and the results above are on that tree.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
